wiki.title: Vice City
wiki.extract:
The City of Vice, commonly known as Vice City or simply Vice and often abbreviated as VC, is a major city due to appear in Grand Theft Auto VI, located in the State of Leonida. 
The city also serves as the county seat of Vice-Dale County.

wiki.title: Leonida Keys
wiki.extract: The Leonida Keys is an archipelago in southern Mariana County, Leonida, due to appear in Grand Theft Auto VI.

wiki.title: Grassrivers
wiki.extract: The Grassrivers is a natural region of flooded grasslands in Leonida, due to appear in Grand Theft Auto VI.

wiki.title: Mariana County
wiki.extract: Mariana County is a county due to appear in Grand Theft Auto VI, located in the southern region of the State of Leonida.

wiki.title: Port Gellhorn
wiki.extract: Port Gellhorn is a city in Kelly County, Leonida, due to appear in Grand Theft Auto VI.

wiki.title: Ambrosia
wiki.extract: Ambrosia is a city in Ambrosia County, Leonida, due to appear in Grand Theft Auto VI.

wiki.title: Leonard County
wiki.extract: Leonard County is a county due to appear in Grand Theft Auto VI, located in the southeastern part of the State of Leonida.

wiki.title: Mount Kalaga National Park
wiki.extract: Mount Kalaga National Park is a national park due to appear in Grand Theft Auto VI, located in Lummox County, Leonida.
